body:
Confirmed on 4.4.1.stable.mono. These are the error messages when running `dotnet build` in a project with the scripts attache to the issue:

```
CSC : warning CS8785: Generator 'ScriptPropertiesGenerator' failed to generate source. It will not contribute to the output and compilation errors may occur as a result. Exception was of type 'NullReferenceException' with message 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'. [C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\overriding-virtual-properties.csproj]

CSC : warning CS8785: Generator 'ScriptSerializationGenerator' failed to generate source. It will not contribute to the output and compilation errors may occur as a result. Exception was of type 'NullReferenceException' with message 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'. [C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\overriding-virtual-properties.csproj]

C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\.godot\mono\temp\obj\Debug\Godot.SourceGenerators\Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptPropertyDefValGenerator\PlayerCore_ScriptPropertyDefVal.generated.cs(16,33): error CS0117: 'Node.PropertyName' does not contain a definition for 'Primary' [C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\overriding-virtual-properties.csproj]

C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\.godot\mono\temp\obj\Debug\Godot.SourceGenerators\Godot.SourceGenerators.ScriptPropertyDefValGenerator\Player.APlayer_ScriptPropertyDefVal.generated.cs(18,33): error CS0117: 'CharacterBody3D.PropertyName' does not contain a definition for 'CameraA' [C:\Users\Benjamin\dev\godot-projects\overriding-virtual-properties\overriding-virtual-properties.csproj]

```

@AThousandShips

godot 4.6.1 still causes this issue

```csharp
public partial class Battler : CharacterBody2D
{
    public virtual string Id { get; protected set; } = string.Empty;
}
```

```csharp
public sealed partial class Player : Battler
{    
    // This will cause the source generator to throw an exception
    public override string Id => "koishi";
}
```

More information about the compilation is as follows:

- Closing as duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/71102
- This should be fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/98396 which will be merged for 4.8
